title: EXP-123 - Hello World Part 8 Phase 5: StdFormPredisplay Set Values FX_Page = 1 and Visible When on FlexLayoutMain's signinpage, homepage and cartpage Regions of FX_CustomerPortal, with a Close/Reopen Readback
objective: Build Hello World Part 8 Phase 5 (09:53-12:16) on FX_CustomerPortal (User scope): a Form event handler on the standard event StdFormPredisplay with Response Type Set Values and one pair FX_Page = 1 (the tutorial's variable Page, FX_-named like FX_Count in EXP-120); then, in FlexLayoutMain's Edit FlexLayout Attributes dialog, a Visible When condition 'variable FX_Page equals literal N' with Visible in Design Mode True on the regions signinpage (1), homepage (2) and cartpage (3). T1 gate, including a read-only look at the region properties; T2 handler; T3 close/reopen check of the handler and the FX_Page variable; T4 to T6 one region each; T7 close/reopen readback and final audit. No runtime check (that follows after Phase 6). Findings are observed only.

Record the worker-written-file inventory and a cumulative browser action audit with exact counts.

Use the existing authenticated session without refresh, restart or configuration change. If a session expiry, logout card or sign-in page appears, record it and stop for the operator (EXP-107: the operator signs in manually); do not navigate, type credentials or screenshot a filled sign-in form. List the browser tabs before the first tab selection. Answer any prompt within the same task; never leave a prompt, dialog, menu or unsaved change open across tasks. After any pause, inspect the state read-only before acting and never replay an earlier action. Signed-out session (EXP-116): a server-event error together with a portal tab reading 'Logout Successful' means the session ended; record it and stop for the operator.

Task boundary: do only what the current task instruction lists and stop at its end, even when later steps of this brief remain; report the next step instead of performing it. Turn budget (EXP-109, EXP-111): if a task cannot finish, stop only at a step boundary right after a Save (never with an unsaved change, open list, editor or dialog) and report the next step.

Server-event rule (EXP-103-R2 lesson): if any action raises 'The server event processing returned an error', answer OK once, record it and stop blocked for an operator Designer reload; never try another route, retry, close or reopen after that error. Console-error stop (EXP-110-R2 lesson: a Caption commit can fail silently with HTTP 400 and surface only at the next server event): record the page console error count shown in the browser tool output at the start of each task and after every action in T1 to T7; if it rises after any action, record the action and the counts and stop blocked before any further click (no ellipsis, no Save, no close), leaving the state for the operator. Never read or inspect the console messages themselves. A rise can also come from a client-side Designer script error (EXP-111 T5: an uncaught TypeError at a component selection); the stop rule is the same, and the operator diagnoses the cause from the tool-written console log. A Caption commit that leaves Save disabled is also a stop signal (EXP-110-R2): record it and stop blocked before any further click.

Editing scope: stay in User scope throughout. If an 'Identify Your Editing Scope' dialog appears, confirm it shows User for the signed-in user and accept it unchanged; if it shows any other scope, Cancel it and stop blocked.

Designer gate (T1, read-only except at most one Form open and one dialog open closed with Cancel): User scope; FX_CustomerPortal open and clean (Save disabled), no dialog open; if another Form tab is active, select FX_CustomerPortal's tab; if it is not open, open it once through the Form menu recent-forms entry (never Select Form OK). Record: Details > Event Handlers (every handler group and row; expected FX_SignInBtn with its Collection Refresh row, and no StdFormPredisplay handler; if a StdFormPredisplay handler exists, record it and stop blocked); Details > Variables (expected FX_Count under Form - Temporary and fds_SC2 under Form - Persistent; no FX_Page; if FX_Page exists, record it and stop blocked); the Components tree's FlexLayoutMain regions (Region00: menu, Region01: spacer1, Region02: signinpage, Region03: homepage, Region04: cartpage, Region05: spacer2). Then select FlexLayoutMain by its Components row Type cell (Properties header 'FlexLayoutMain (FlexLayout)'), open its Edit FlexLayout Attributes adorner once (by reference, the flexlayouteditadorner id, or by tooltip; EXP-105, EXP-112), confirm the dialog shows Type, Auto Size and a Regions grid with exactly the six regions above (if not, Cancel and stop blocked), select the signinpage row and record every property group and row of the region Properties grid (expanding groups is view only), in particular the exact names and current values of the Visible When and Visible in Design Mode rows (or whatever the Behavior group lists); open no ellipsis or list; leave with Cancel and verify Save is still disabled. Record the baseline console error count. Screenshots: the Event Handlers tab; the Variables tab; the dialog with the signinpage region's Behavior rows.

Efficiency rules (operator, 2026-10-16): screenshots only for the decisive states named in this brief; do not re-open saved images unless a decision needs it; one untargeted snapshot per step; read only the named sources; never search or read the worker's own session transcript. Use inline untargeted snapshots; never save snapshots to files and Grep them (EXP-109 ran out of turns that way). Lists (EXP-111 lesson): choose a list option by clicking it; never pick options with arrow keys, Enter or Tab while a list is open, because Tab commits the highlighted item. Stale references (operator ruling, EXP-111): the allowance is one fresh untargeted snapshot per 'Ref not found' error, not one per task. Snapshot size (EXP-114): if an untargeted snapshot is too large to return inline, take targeted snapshots of the needed panel instead (record that); never save snapshots to files.

Property rules (EXP-055, EXP-056, EXP-111, EXP-122): select a component by its Components row (click its Type cell) and confirm the Properties header names it. Lists: open the list with its arrow and click the planned option, then leave the field by clicking a neutral row (never Tab or arrow keys while a list is open); if the planned option is absent, close the list without choosing and stop blocked before any OK or Save. Text fields: click the value cell, one plain fill, one Tab; verify. At most one correction per field. Record the console error count after each action. After each performed step exactly one Designer Save, recording its response and the Save state. Answer an OK-only informational prompt with OK and record it verbatim; any other prompt not covered here: record it, choose the non-changing answer (No or Cancel) and stop blocked. Close every nested dialog you opened with its OK (planned change) or Cancel (no change), innermost first; never leave one open across tasks.

StdFormPredisplay handler (T2; EXP-055 and EXP-056 routes): Details > Event Handlers > New (+) once; in the New dialog pick StdFormPredisplay from the event-name drop-down (click the option; if absent, Cancel and stop blocked), OK once; record the new group and row. Select the row; Response Type list: click Set Values. Open the Parameters ellipsis once ('Edit Set Values' / Event Handler Parameters); open the Variables ellipsis once (an 'Edit Set Variable Values' list, expected empty); New once ('Edit Set Variable Value Pair'); type FX_Page into the Target combobox key by key and commit with Tab (EXP-056: a new name typed there is kept; never pick another variable from its list); fill Value 1 and Tab; verify both; OK on the pair dialog, then OK on each enclosing dialog. Verify the handler row reads Response Type Set Values and Parameters SETVARVALUES(FX_Page=1) (record the exact text). One Designer Save. Screenshots: the New dialog with StdFormPredisplay chosen; the pair dialog before OK; the handler row before the Save; the Save response state.

Handler persistence check (T3, read-only except one close and one reopen): close the clean FX_CustomerPortal once through its Form-tab control (answer No to any save prompt, record its text), reopen it once through the Form menu recent-forms entry, and read Details > Event Handlers (StdFormPredisplay > Set Values > SETVARVALUES(FX_Page=1); FX_SignInBtn unchanged) and Details > Variables (record whether FX_Page now appears and in which category; EXP-057: a typed Set Values target appeared as a Form - Temporary variable after a Save and reopen). No change and no Save. Screenshots: Event Handlers; Variables.

Region Visible When (T4 signinpage = 1; T5 homepage = 2; T6 cartpage = 3; one region per task, built with the expression builder each time): select FlexLayoutMain by its Components row, open its Edit FlexLayout Attributes dialog once, confirm the six regions, select the task's region row. Open the Visible When ellipsis once and record the builder dialog (title, controls) before acting. Build the condition as narrated: New; left value type Variable value with value FX_Page (choose FX_Page from the list if offered, otherwise type it); operator equal (=); edit the right value: value type Literal, value N; OK on each builder dialog; verify and record the exact Visible When text in the region Properties. If the builder lacks these controls or shows anything unexpected, Cancel the builder, Cancel the attributes dialog and stop blocked. Then set Visible in Design Mode to True (list option) in the same dialog visit; if that row is absent, Cancel the attributes dialog (discarding the condition) and stop blocked. Verify both values, OK the attributes dialog once, confirm the canvas still shows the region's components, then one Designer Save. Never copy and paste an expression; never edit another region or any region ID, Length, Unit, Orientation, Alignment, Pack or Margin. Screenshots per task: the builder at open; the builder before its final OK; the region's Behavior rows before the attributes OK; the Save response state.

Readback and audit (T7, one task): close the clean FX_CustomerPortal once through its Form-tab control (answer No to any save prompt, record its text), reopen it once through the Form menu recent-forms entry, read Details > Event Handlers (StdFormPredisplay > Set Values > SETVARVALUES(FX_Page=1); FX_SignInBtn unchanged) and Details > Variables (FX_Page), open FlexLayoutMain's Edit FlexLayout Attributes dialog once and read, for each of the six regions, Visible When and Visible in Design Mode (signinpage, homepage and cartpage as planned; menu, spacer1 and spacer2 unchanged from T1's reading where T1 read them, otherwise recorded), then Cancel. Record what the canvas shows. Open no ellipsis or list. Leave FX_CustomerPortal open and clean. Then, in the same task, write the documentation-only final audit into the record: decisive evidence for each acceptance check, the cumulative action audit with exact counts, the worker-written-file inventory, the cleanup inventory and the final state. Screenshots: Event Handlers; Variables; the dialog on each of the three regions' Behavior rows.

initial_instruction: T1 - Read-only gate for EXP-123. First read the repository file AGENTS.md, then hello-world-pt8.md lines 156-168 and transcript lines 410-433, recipes/session/session-expiry-and-stale-designer.md, and only the Outcome (operator) sections of EXP-122, EXP-120, EXP-117, EXP-112, EXP-057, EXP-056 and EXP-055, all before any browser action; read nothing else. Without shell/git access, record the starting state concisely. List the browser tabs before selecting one; identify the Web Client and Web Designer tabs. If either shows a session expiry, logout card, 'Logout Successful' or sign-in, record it and stop for the operator (do not sign in; never screenshot a filled sign-in form). Record the page console error count shown in the tool output (do not read the messages); if it rises after any action, record the action and stop. In the Designer confirm User scope, that FX_CustomerPortal is open and clean (select its Form tab if another is active; open it once through the Form menu recent-forms entry only if it is not open) and that no dialog is open. If any action raises the server-event error, answer OK once, record it and stop. Record Details > Event Handlers (no StdFormPredisplay handler expected), Details > Variables (no FX_Page expected) and FlexLayoutMain's six regions in the Components tree. Select FlexLayoutMain by its Components row Type cell, open its Edit FlexLayout Attributes dialog once, confirm Type, Auto Size and the six-row Regions grid, select the signinpage row and record the region Properties grid, especially the Visible When and Visible in Design Mode rows (names and values); open no ellipsis or list; Cancel; verify Save is still disabled. Screenshots: Event Handlers; Variables; the dialog with signinpage's Behavior rows. Use inline snapshots only (targeted panel snapshots if an untargeted one is too large). Make no change in T1. This is the end of T1 even though later brief steps remain. Create the EXP-123 record with the gate, the readings, the action audit and the file inventory, with screenshots under evidence/EXP-123/ (distinct filenames), and stop with no dialog open.
notes: Part 8 Phase 5 after EXP-122 (Phase 4 accepted 2026-10-20), drafted by the operator assistant from the EXP-122 brief with the handler route of EXP-055, the Set Values pair route of EXP-056/EXP-057 and the FlexLayout attributes dialog route of EXP-105/EXP-112. Tutorial mapping: Standard Form Pre-Display -> StdFormPredisplay; variable Page -> FX_Page (FX_ naming as FX_Count, EXP-120); Sign-In Page / Home Page / Cart Page -> regions signinpage / homepage / cartpage of FlexLayoutMain; 'visible win' -> Visible When (property names confirmed in T1 before use); 'visible and design mode' -> Visible in Design Mode. Deviation from the tutorial: it copies the first expression and pastes it into the other two regions; this brief builds each with the expression builder (no clipboard). T3 is an extra close/reopen check because EXP-057 saw a typed Set Values target become a Form - Temporary variable only after Save and reopen, and T4 needs FX_Page in the builder. No runtime check here: with FX_Page = 1 on open only signinpage should show at runtime, and the navigation that changes FX_Page is Phase 6. Planned tasks: T1 gate (one dialog open, Cancel); T2 handler (1 Save); T3 close/reopen check; T4 signinpage, T5 homepage, T6 cartpage (1 Save each); T7 close/reopen readback and final audit. exact_values: FX_Page, StdFormPredisplay. deny_browser_javascript. Approved by the operator on 2026-10-20 (Mongoose logged in with no unsaved changes).
